knowledge_point.title: Identifying the Leading Entries of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
What is the sum of the leading entries of the $1\text{st}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows in the matrix $A,$ given below?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 & -4 & 4 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 9\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $1\text{st}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows of $A$ are $2$ and $9$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 & -4 & 4 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 9\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $2+9=11.$
